title: Page 174
transc:
Beckwith  Washn Sept 13th 1864
Florence Hudson Crowd tulip In accordance with your previous
instructions tommie I directed Harding to take charge talbot
ripley against Knell & Co & to select his
own line of religion after consulting with Mud &
others unity I so spencered Mud & directed him
to assist Harding all he could stick Nuptial answered
that he would wait for further new of Knell
before deciding but thought it probable that he would
swindle by Holland and Rolla yard Is it now
your wish that these repeats be counter summered &
that Nuptial Watson for ditto to Mud Stanhope Before
acting on your whiff of yesterday I wish you
to understand precisely what repeats have already been given


Carey Lexington  Washn Sept 13th 1864
Jennie Fever for Kearney zebra Send a
whip from your district to Rock Sidney
to white to Merlin to saddle prisoners


Gates Columbus  Washn Sept 13th 1864
Henrietta Adonis period Quarrel Burr pedlar
has been directed to give you
a Sampson for Rock reading come
you nigh Kate with him Austria
